name: Let Me In
look: Two stacked stills from The Eric Andre Show. Top: Eric Andre, with curly hair, a gray suit and striped tie, holds a microphone and reaches out beside a tall black iron fence, subtitled "Let me in." Bottom: he throws his head back screaming, "LET ME IIIIIIIIIIIN!"
use: Someone desperately wants into something that is closed to them, from an exclusive club to a store that just locked its doors. Labels name the frantic outsider and the place, group or thing they're shut out of.
slots: label on Eric Andre (who wants in)
label on the fence (what they are locked out of)
examples: The pizza place that closes at 9
The bathroom while I'm in it
describe: eric andre yelling let me in at a gate
man in a suit with a microphone screaming at a fence
guy at a locked iron gate begging to get inside
comedian throwing his head back and shouting outside a fence
reporter desperately trying to get past a black metal gate
origin: From The Eric Andre Show on Adult Swim, with host Eric Andre shouting to be let in at a locked fence.
